title: 番外3 振翅横绝九天免费可跳过番外2 安如玉的时间线免费可跳过
content_zh:
许多年前，北原的密林深处。
两人仓皇逃窜，身上衣袍的纹路象征着天魔宗的出身，而观其气息，二人皆是神通初期的修为。
不久前，天魔宗、黄泉山还有血河道，邪魔六道出动半数，试图截杀前往北溟洲任职一洲镇守的陆怀清。
但最终，仍是功败垂成。
不知是内部出了细作，还是那陆怀清早有预料，反而设计将他们伏杀一通。
他们二人是外围负责打探消息的，侥幸逃脱，一路慌不择路地逃入深山。
就在二人以为已经甩去了追兵，准备休息一二时。
前方山路的尽头，不知何时站了一个人。
那是个道人，就那么随意地站在山林中，背对着他们，仰头看天，也不知在看什么。
“谁？”为首的青年低喝一声，手已按上了腰间的刀柄。
那人转过身来，露出一张并不出奇的脸，肩膀上停着一只灰扑扑的雀儿，正在用喙梳理着羽毛。
“两个神通初期。”他自言自语道，“本座如今神通后期，嗯，高你们两境，以一敌二，差不多。”
两人突然面露绝望。
只因他们认出了眼前之人。
天鹏道场的陈蜉蝣！
此人自出道以来，只要出手，就没输过，哪怕名声再不好听，可也意味着但凡他出手，就有着十成把握。
其中一人退无可退，眼中决然一闪，忽然仰天大笑：
“扶摇道人？哈哈哈！陈蜉蝣！你这种只知以大欺小之人居然也配成就道芽仙胚？我——”
呸字尚未出口，一只手已经捏住了他的喉咙。
快……太快了！

他甚至没看清这位是如何出的手，脖子就被一只铁钳般的手死死箍住，身上的罡气在这只手面前形同虚设。
他这才猛然想起，眼前之人，从多年前开始，就被称为有“振翅横绝九天”之象。
而这句话在一开始并非褒奖，反而是实打实的讽刺。
用来嘲讽这位跑路、脱身之快，从不让自身陷入险境。
最初的原话，是——逃命的本事，当真是振翅横绝九天。
可随着这位一路登高，在神通境铸就道芽仙胚，元神内相显化后，竟是真的有了几分“振翅横绝九天”的气象！
而那道芽仙基，乃是神通境的极尽，不知多少神通武者，连门槛都看不见，更别说踏入其中！
此刻。
被道人锁住脖子的男人犹自不甘，嘲讽道：“陈蜉蝣，你的武道就是以大欺小吗？”
道人丝毫不怒，反而莞尔一笑道：“你什么境界，什么实力，也配和我谈论武道？”
男人还想说些什么，道人却没给他机会。
随着咔擦两声。
两具尸体就这么倒在了山林中。
做完这一切，道人衣衫都未曾乱，肩头灰雀歪着头看着他，举翅示意向另一方向。
陈蜉蝣抬头望去，摇头道：“不妥，那黄鹤散人乃是神通后期的武者，与本座同境，虽然受了重伤，但本座何等金贵，岂能和他以伤换命。”
灰雀叽叽叽叫了几声，扑腾着翅膀，颇有些恨铁不成钢的模样。
“你看，你又急。”道人丝毫不以为意，“拿人钱财，与人消灾，陆怀清那边可没付我对付神通后期的钱。”
“当然。”
他突然一笑，
“他就算付了，本座也是只收钱不办事。”

灰雀双翼遮眼，似乎根本没眼看。
而道人却丝毫不在意，抬头望去，穷尽目光，不知在看向何处。
名为陈蜉蝣的道人，自童年起，就在反复做着一场黄粱大梦，梦中他仿佛回到了太古，直面上一次的末劫。
content_en:
Many years ago, deep in the dense forests of Beiyuan.
The two of them fled in a hurry. The patterns on their robes symbolized their origins from the Heavenly Demon Sect, and looking at their auras, they both had early-stage magical abilities.
Not long ago, Tianmo Sect, Huangquan Mountain and Blood River Road, half of the Six Demonic Paths were dispatched to try to intercept and kill Lu Huaiqing who was going to Beiming Continent to serve as a guard for the first continent.
But in the end, it still failed.
I don't know if there was some internal conspiracy, or if Lu Huaiqing had anticipated it and planned to ambush them.
The two of them were responsible for inquiring about information from the outside. They escaped by chance and fled into the mountains in a panic.
Just when the two thought they had shaken off their pursuers, they were about to take a rest.
At the end of the mountain road ahead, I don’t know when a person stood.
That was a Taoist, standing so casually in the forest, with his back to them, looking up at the sky, not knowing what he was looking at.
"Who?" The leading young man shouted, his hand already pressed on the handle of the knife at his waist.
The man turned around, revealing an ordinary face. There was a gray bird on his shoulder, preening its feathers with its beak.
"Two in the early stage of magical power." He said to himself, "I am now in the advanced stage of magical power. Well, I am two levels higher than you. One versus two, almost."
The two suddenly looked desperate.
Just because they recognized the person in front of them.
Chen Mayfly from Tianpeng Dojo!
Since his debut, this person has never lost as long as he makes a move. No matter how bad his reputation is, it still means that whenever he makes a move, he is 100% sure.
One of them had no choice but to retreat, and with a flash of determination in his eyes, he suddenly looked up to the sky and laughed:
"Fuyao Taoist? Hahaha! Chen Mayfly! How can someone like you, who only knows how to bully the small, be worthy of becoming a Taoist Bud Immortal Embryo? I——"
Before the word "bah" came out of his mouth, a hand had already pinched his throat.
Fast... too fast!
He didn't even see how this person moved his hand, and his neck was tightly clamped by an iron-like hand, and the aura on his body was useless in front of this hand.
Then he suddenly remembered that the person in front of him had been said to have the phenomenon of "fluttering wings across the nine heavens" many years ago.
And this sentence was not a compliment at the beginning, but a real irony.
Used to mock this person for running away and escaping quickly, never putting himself in danger.
The original words at the beginning were - the ability to escape can really fly across the sky.
But as this person ascended all the way, he created the Dao Bud Immortal Embryo in the realm of supernatural powers, and after the inner phase of the Yuan Shen manifested, he actually had a bit of a "wings flying across the nine heavens"!
And that Dao Immortal Base is the ultimate level of magical power. I don’t know how many magical warriors can’t even see the threshold, let alone step into it!
now.
The man whose neck was locked by the Taoist was still unwilling to accept it, and mocked: "Chen Yufang, is your martial arts all about using the big to bully the small?"
The Taoist was not angry at all, but smiled and said: "What level and strength do you have, are you worthy of talking about martial arts with me?"
The man wanted to say something more, but the Taoist didn't give him a chance.
With two clicks.
The two bodies just fell in the forest.
After doing all this, the Taoist's clothes were not in a mess. The gray bird on his shoulder tilted its head and looked at him, raising its wings to indicate in the other direction.
Chen Mayfly looked up, shook his head and said, "No, that Huanghe Sanren is a warrior in the late stage of supernatural power. He is in the same realm as me. Although he was seriously injured, I am so valuable that I can't trade my injury with him for my life."
The gray bird chirped a few times and flapped its wings, looking like it hated iron for not becoming steel.
"Look, you are in a hurry." The Taoist didn't care at all. "Take people's money to eliminate disasters. Lu Huaiqing didn't pay me to deal with the late stage of magical power."
"Of course."
He suddenly smiled,
"Even if he pays, I will only collect the money and not do anything."
The gray bird covered its eyes with its wings, seemingly unable to see at all.
But the Taoist didn't care at all. He raised his head and looked around, not knowing where he was looking.
A Taoist named Chen Mayfly has been doing this repeatedly since childhood.He was having a big dream, in which he seemed to have returned to ancient times and faced the last catastrophe head-on.
